name: MegaGargomon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] For each green Tamer you have in play, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. They don't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP to its owner's hand.
